data.title: Lido Crypto Validator Consolidation Will Cut Ethereum’s Beacon Chain by 29%
data.description: Lido Crypto has launched its Core 2026 protocol upgrade, introducing native 0x02 validator support to its largest staking module, restructuring node operator economics around ETH-backed bonds, and setting in motion a validator consolidation that will reduce the total number of Ethereum validators by roughly one-third.
